mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_ETCFRM_M ( FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, DIVS_CD, PPCD, FRM_CFY, FRM_NM, HOLD_SCCD, USER_OFCD, OPPB_CFY, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, DLT_YN ) VALUES ( #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{DIVS_CD}, #{PPCD}, #{FRM_CFY}, #{FRM_NM}, #{HOLD_SCCD}, #{USER_OFCD}, #{OPPB_CFY}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, 'N' )

mapper.select: SELECT FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_CFY, FRM_NM, HOLD_SCCD, USER_OFCD, OPPB_CFY, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT, (SELECT ATFL_GRUP_NM||'/'||ATFL_PHCL_NM||'.'||ATFL_FEXT_NM FROM GE_MP_FILE_S WHERE ATFL_GRUP_NM = 'GE_MP_ETCFRM_M' AND UNQ_NO = A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND ATFL_ID = '1') AS ATFL_PHCL_NM FROM GE_MP_ETCFRM_M A WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}
